chapter_title: Concerning the Ten Things that the Ambassador bega
spiritual_reading:
The Divine proceeded from within Itself to establish a new order of spiritual life, arranging it into a form fit for reception and use.

Higher forms of doctrine and ordered knowledges were carried through elevated states of the inner mind, so that what is from heaven could be brought into right connection.

The agencies of orderly operation in the outermost degree began to transmit living influence downward into the natural level and also into the higher interior levels, so that life might descend and be distributed according to degree.

The fourth portion of the teaching is absent here, so the spiritual sequence cannot be fully traced at this point; what should stand in the series is unclear.

The outermost means of admission were set into activity, so that what had been closed in externals was opened for the reception of influx from within and for the orderly outflow into works.

These outermost means of admission were also opened for the reception and removal of what is rejected by heaven: the impure residuum of falsity and evil that must be taken up into order to be separated and cast away.

The active evil that had been held apart from the dominant falsities by a mediating Divine operation was permitted to descend into the natural degree, where it could no longer remain hidden among interior reasonings but would be encountered in the outer life.

States of obscurity and states of illumination were distinguished and set in their proper alternation, so that the mind might know when it is in falsity and when it is in truth.

The perversions and dead formations of life that cannot be brought to birth as genuine good and truth were brought down into the outermost level, there to be exposed and ended.

There followed a cycle of changes of state within the intermediate region between inner and outer life, in which affections and thoughts were shifted and re-assigned according to their quality; yet the precise spiritual meaning of this portion is partly uncertain because the wording is extremely compressed and lacks the connecting teaching that would show whether these changes were ordered for restoration or were the result of disorder.

fills.fill: The measures were set in their places in the zone.
fills.notes: The series lists ten ordered operations in the establishing of the new aeon. After the ‘wheels’ transmit life downward (ordered operations in ultimates), the next correspondential step is the fixing of limits, times, and bounds in the intermediate region (the zone) so that subsequent openings of the ship-doors can function as regulated admissions and expulsions. Thus ‘measures’ (bounds, determinations) being set in the zone fits the cosmological register of the oldest substrate and prepares for ¶6–7 (openings for influx and for the removal of waste).

fills.fill: from each other in the zone
fills.notes: Night and day correspond to obscurity and illumination; their ‘separation’ requires an ordered alternation within the intermediate region where states are successively arranged. Adding ‘from each other’ expresses discrete distinction (not mixture), and ‘in the zone’ anchors the operation in the same middle region that governs the subsequent state-changes (¶11).

assessment: Two lacunae are trivial (¶8, ¶10). The missing fourth item is only moderately recoverable: the correspondential sequence strongly suggests the establishment of measures or bounds in the zone between transmission (¶4) and the opening of doors for influx and expulsion (¶6–7), but the exact noun could vary (limits, measures, ordinances). The night-day clause is fairly constrained: it must express discrete distinction and likely locate it in the zone, though alternative short completions remain possible.
